title: OKF Conventions Used in This Bundle
description: How this bundle applies Google's Open Knowledge Format v0.2 and which producer extension keys it adds.

title: Relation Vocabulary
description: Controlled list of predicates allowed in the `relations:` extension key.

title: Concept Type Vocabulary
description: The `type` values used in this bundle and what each means.

title: Data Governance & Licensing Rules for Agents
description: Rules an agent must follow when combining US pharma commercial datasets: PHI, licences, AMA PDRP, projection.

title: Data Quality Rules
description: Standard normalisation and validation rules for pharma commercial data.

title: Brand Manufacturer
description: Company holding an NDA/BLA that markets branded drugs, sets WAC, contracts with PBMs/GPOs and funds patient programmes.

title: Generic Manufacturer
description: Holder of an ANDA selling bioequivalent copies after patent/exclusivity expiry.

title: Biosimilar Manufacturer
description: Holder of a 351(k) BLA for a biosimilar or interchangeable biologic.

title: Labeler
description: Any firm named by an NDC labeler code: manufacturer, repackager, relabeler or private-label distributor.

title: Third-Party Logistics Provider (3PL)
description: Warehouses manufacturer-owned inventory and ships orders to wholesalers and direct accounts; often also runs order-to-cash and sends 867 sales data.

title: ICS (Integrated Commercialization Solutions, Cencora)
description: Cencora's North American 3PL brand; ships manufacturer product and delivers ICS 867 sales/returns data and analytics.

title: Full-Line Wholesaler
description: Buys from manufacturers at WAC and supplies pharmacies, hospitals and clinics; the Big Three are McKesson, Cencora and Cardinal Health.

title: Specialty Distributor
description: Distributor serving physician offices, infusion centres and hospitals with physician-administered and specialty drugs (buy-and-bill).

title: Group Purchasing Organization (GPO)
description: Negotiates contract prices on behalf of hospitals, IDNs and clinics; its contracts drive wholesaler chargebacks.

title: Retail Pharmacy
description: Chain or independent community pharmacy dispensing outpatient prescriptions and submitting NCPDP claims.

title: Mail-Order Pharmacy
description: Central-fill pharmacy, usually PBM-owned, shipping maintenance drugs.

title: Specialty Pharmacy (SP)
description: Dispenses high-cost/complex drugs with clinical support; sends status and dispense data to manufacturers under data agreements.

title: Long-Term Care Pharmacy
description: Serves nursing homes and assisted-living facilities.

title: 340B Contract Pharmacy
description: Pharmacy dispensing 340B-priced drug on behalf of a covered entity.

title: Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM)
description: Adjudicates pharmacy claims, builds formularies, contracts pharmacy networks and negotiates manufacturer rebates for plan sponsors.

title: Express Scripts (Cigna/Evernorth)
description: Largest US PBM by claims share in 2025.

title: CVS Caremark
description: CVS Health's PBM.

title: Optum Rx
description: UnitedHealth Group's PBM.

title: Commercial Payer
description: Employer or individual-market health plan; the only channel eligible for manufacturer copay cards.

title: Medicare Part D
description: Outpatient drug benefit for Medicare beneficiaries delivered by private PDP/MA-PD plans.

title: Medicare Part B
description: Medical benefit covering physician-administered drugs, paid at ASP + 6% under buy-and-bill.

title: Medicaid
description: State-federal programme; outpatient drugs carry statutory MDRP rebates.

title: VA / DoD / PHS
description: Federal purchasers buying at FSS / Federal Ceiling Price.

title: Healthcare Professional (HCP)
description: Individual prescriber or clinician (physician, NP, PA, etc.).

title: Healthcare Organization (HCO)
description: Hospital, clinic, infusion centre, dialysis unit, practice or other organisation that buys, administers or bills drugs.

title: Integrated Delivery Network (IDN)
description: Health system owning multiple hospitals and practices; the top of the HCO hierarchy (`SYS_VID` / `AFFILIATED_SYSTEM_VID` in the warehouse).

title: 340B Covered Entity
description: HRSA-registered hospital or grantee entitled to 340B ceiling prices.

title: Dialysis Provider
description: Dialysis organisation (e.g. large dialysis chains) administering IV drugs such as iron; hemodialysis volume is often separated in IV iron analytics.

title: FDA
description: Food and Drug Administration: approvals (CDER/CBER), labeling, promotion (OPDP), safety, NDC listing, DSCSA.

title: CMS
description: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services: Medicare/Medicaid, NPPES, Open Payments, ASP/AMP reporting, IRA negotiation.

title: HHS-OIG
description: HHS Office of Inspector General: Anti-Kickback enforcement, advisory opinions, fraud alerts.

title: DEA
description: Drug Enforcement Administration: controlled-substance scheduling, registrations, EPCS, ARCOS.

title: HRSA Office of Pharmacy Affairs
description: Administers the 340B Drug Pricing Program and OPAIS registry.

title: State Boards of Pharmacy
description: License pharmacies, wholesalers and 3PLs; run PDMPs.

title: NCPDP
description: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs: Telecommunication D.0, SCRIPT, ePA, provider IDs.

title: ASC X12
description: Accredited Standards Committee X12: EDI 837/835/270/271/278 and supply-chain 850/856/867/852/844/849.

title: HL7
description: Health Level Seven: HL7 v2 and FHIR clinical/financial interoperability standards.

title: Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
description: 1938 statute governing drug safety, efficacy, approval, labeling and misbranding.

title: Hatch-Waxman Act
description: 1984 law creating the ANDA generic pathway, Orange Book patent listing, Paragraph IV challenges and 180-day exclusivity.

title: Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act
description: 2010 law creating the 351(k) biosimilar/interchangeable pathway and 12-year reference exclusivity.

title: Drug Supply Chain Security Act
description: 2013 law requiring package-level serialisation and interoperable electronic tracing between trading partners.

title: Controlled Substances Act
description: Establishes Schedules I–V, DEA registration, EPCS and ARCOS reporting.

title: Prescription Drug Marketing Act
description: 1987 law governing drug samples: written requests, signed receipts, inventory reconciliation.

title: Inflation Reduction Act (drug provisions)
description: 2022 law creating Medicare drug price negotiation (MFP), Part D redesign, the Manufacturer Discount Program and inflation rebates.

title: Investigational New Drug (IND)
description: Application required before first-in-human trials.

title: Clinical Trial Phases
description: Phase 1 safety, Phase 2 dose/efficacy, Phase 3 pivotal, Phase 4 post-marketing.

title: NDA 505(b)(1)
description: Full New Drug Application with the sponsor's own safety/efficacy data.

title: NDA 505(b)(2)
description: NDA relying partly on literature or prior FDA findings (new forms, combinations).

title: ANDA 505(j)
description: Abbreviated application for generics proving bioequivalence.

title: BLA 351(a)
description: Biologics License Application for novel biologics.

title: Biosimilar 351(k)
description: Abbreviated pathway for biosimilar or interchangeable biologics.

title: REMS
description: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy; may restrict prescribing/dispensing (ETASU).

title: Pharmacovigilance & FAERS
description: Adverse-event collection and reporting (15-day expedited reports) into FDA FAERS; reps must forward AEs heard in calls.

title: OPDP & Promotional Rules
description: FDA Office of Prescription Drug Promotion reviews Form 2253 submissions; promotion must be consistent with the label.

title: Off-Label Promotion Restrictions
description: Manufacturers may not promote unapproved uses; MSLs may answer unsolicited requests.

title: 21 CFR Part 11
description: Requirements for electronic records and signatures (CRM sample signatures, eTMF).

title: NDC 12-Digit Final Rule
description: FDA rule moving the NDC to a uniform 12-digit 6-4-2 format.

title: Anti-Kickback Statute
description: Criminal prohibition on remuneration to induce federally reimbursed business; reason copay cards exclude government-insured patients.

title: False Claims Act
description: Civil liability (with qui tam whistleblowers) for causing false federal claims; basis of off-label and kickback settlements.

title: Stark Law
description: Prohibits physician self-referral for designated health services.

title: Physician Payments Sunshine Act (Open Payments)
description: Requires manufacturers/GPOs to report transfers of value to physicians, NPPs and teaching hospitals.

title: PhRMA Code on Interactions with HCPs
description: Voluntary industry code on meals, speaker programmes and gifts.

title: HIPAA Privacy Rule
description: Governs use and disclosure of PHI by covered entities and business associates.

title: HIPAA De-identification
description: PHI is de-identified by Safe Harbor (remove 18 identifiers) or Expert Determination (very small re-identification risk); the basis for tokenised claims data.

title: Limited Data Set
description: PHI with direct identifiers removed but dates/zip retained, usable under a Data Use Agreement.

title: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program
description: Manufacturers pay states quarterly rebates (URA × units) based on AMP and Best Price; cap removed from 2024.

title: 340B Drug Pricing Program
description: Covered entities buy outpatient drugs at the ceiling price (AMP − URA), mostly via wholesaler chargebacks.

title: 340B Rebate Model Pilot
description: HRSA pilot letting manufacturers pay 340B discounts as post-sale rebates; vacated Feb 2026, relaunched Aug 2026 for MFP-selected drugs.

title: Sorrell v. IMS Health (2011)
description: Supreme Court struck down Vermont's ban on using prescriber-identifiable data for marketing, keeping prescriber-level Rx data legal.

title: AMA Physician Data Restriction Program
description: Lets physicians opt out of reps seeing their prescribing data; surfaced as a PDRP opt-out flag in Rx and claims feeds.

title: State Marketing & Disclosure Laws
description: State gift bans, spend disclosure (e.g. VT, MA, MN) and rep licensing.

title: National Drug Code (NDC)
description: FDA three-segment product identifier (labeler-product-package) for US drugs.

title: NDC-12 (6-4-2)
description: Uniform 12-digit NDC format mandated from 7 Mar 2033.

title: RxNorm RxCUI
description: NLM normalized clinical drug concept identifier, linking NDCs across labelers.

title: GPI (Medi-Span)
description: 14-character Generic Product Identifier hierarchy from drug group to strength.

title: GCN / HICL (First Databank)
description: First Databank formulation (GCN) and ingredient (HICL) codes.

title: ATC Code
description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification.

title: USC (IQVIA Uniform System of Classification)
description: IQVIA therapeutic class code used in Xponent, NPA and LAAD (`USC_CODE`).

title: CMF / Product Group ID (IQVIA)
description: IQVIA product codes (`CMF10`, `PRODUCT_GROUP_ID`) used in audit deliverables instead of NDC.

title: HCPCS Level II (J-codes)
description: CMS codes for physician-administered drugs on medical claims; billing units differ from NDC units.

title: National Provider Identifier (NPI)
description: CMS-issued 10-digit ID; Type 1 = individual HCP, Type 2 = organisation.

title: NUCC Taxonomy Code
description: 10-character provider specialty code recorded in NPPES.

title: DEA Registration Number
description: Registration per location for controlled substances; widely used as a ship-to identifier in 867 data (`CUST_DEA`, `HCO_DEA`).

title: HIN (HIBCC Health Industry Number)
description: Location identifier used in contracts, chargebacks and 867 ship-to data (`CUST_HIN`).

title: AMA ME Number
description: Medical Education number from the AMA Physician Masterfile (`ME_NUMBER` in Xponent).

title: IQVIA Prescriber ID
description: IQVIA's prescriber key in Xponent (`IMS_PRESCRIBER_ID`), mapped to NPI/ME#.

title: IQVIA OneKey ID
description: Identifier for HCPs/HCOs in IQVIA OneKey reference data.

title: Veeva Network VID
description: Veeva OpenData/Network ID for HCPs (`HCP_VID`), HCOs (`ORG_VID`, `HCO_VID`) and systems (`SYS_VID`, `SYSTEM_VID`); the master key in the ICS Sales Warehouse.

title: NCPDP Provider ID
description: 7-digit pharmacy identifier (formerly NABP number).

title: 340B ID
description: HRSA OPAIS covered-entity identifier.

title: CMS Certification Number
description: Medicare provider number for hospitals and facilities.

title: IQVIA DDD Outlet Number
description: IQVIA outlet key in DDD (`dddoutletnum`) with an outlet class/subcategory.

title: BIN / PCN / Group
description: Pharmacy-benefit routing triplet: BIN (processor), PCN (plan/line of business), Group (employer/benefit).

title: Payer Plan ID
description: Vendor plan key (e.g. IQVIA `PAYER_PLAN_ID`, LAAD `PLAN_ID`) mapping to payer, PBM, model (commercial, Part D, Medicaid).

title: CMS Contract-PBP
description: Medicare Part D/MA contract and plan benefit package ID (e.g. H1234-001).

title: De-identified Patient Token
description: Hashed identifier derived from PII (name, DOB, sex, zip) that links one patient across de-identified datasets without exposing identity.

title: FDA Orange Book
description: Approved drugs with therapeutic-equivalence codes, patents and exclusivities.

title: FDA Purple Book
description: Licensed biologics, biosimilars and interchangeables with exclusivity data.

title: FDA NDC Directory
description: Daily-updated list of listed NDCs and package descriptions.

title: Drug Compendia (FDB, Medi-Span)
description: Commercial drug files with WAC/AWP history, packaging, GPI/GCN and clinical attributes.

title: Product Master
description: Internal hierarchy brand → molecule → form → strength → NDC-9 → NDC-11 with market-basket membership.

title: Market Basket Definition
description: The set of competitor and own products defining a market for share calculations (warehouse: `market_basket_treatments`).

title: NDC–HCPCS Crosswalk
description: CMS ASP crosswalk mapping J-codes to NDCs with billing-unit conversion.

title: Specialty & Profession Codes
description: Vendor (IQVIA/AMA) and NUCC specialty codes used for HCP segmentation.

title: Prescription
description: A prescriber's order specifying drug, strength, quantity, directions, refills and DAW; identified at the pharmacy by Rx number + fill number.

title: E-Prescribing
description: Electronic transmission of prescriptions from EHR to pharmacy using NCPDP SCRIPT over a network such as Surescripts.

title: NCPDP SCRIPT
description: Standard for NewRx, RxRenewal, RxChange, CancelRx, RxFill and ePA messages.

title: EPCS
description: DEA-compliant e-prescribing of controlled substances requiring two-factor authentication.

title: Real-Time Prescription Benefit
description: Patient-specific cost and coverage check at the point of prescribing.

title: Prior Authorization (PA / ePA)
description: Payer approval required before coverage; electronic PA uses NCPDP ePA; reject code 75 signals PA required.

title: Formulary, Tiers & Utilization Management
description: Plan list of covered drugs with tiers, exclusions, step therapy and quantity limits.

title: Dispensing & Adjudication
description: Pharmacy selects NDC, quantity, days supply and fill number, submits a real-time claim and dispenses on approval.

title: Prescription Abandonment & Reversal
description: An approved claim not picked up is reversed (B2); abandonment rate = reversed / (paid + reversed).

title: Prescription Drug Monitoring Program
description: State database of dispensed controlled substances, reported in ASAP format.

title: NRx (New Prescriptions)
description: Prescriptions with fill number 0 (definitions vary by vendor).

title: TRx (Total Prescriptions)
description: New prescriptions plus refills.

title: NBRx (New-to-Brand Rx)
description: Prescriptions for patients new to the brand (new starts, switches, add-ons); needs patient-level data such as LAAD `NEW_TO_BRAND_YN`.

title: Extended Units / Volume
description: Dispensed quantity in units (tablets, mL, vials); used for unit-based share and for injectables.

title: Source of Business
description: Classification of a brand Rx as new start, switch, add-on, continuing or restart (LAAD `SOURCE_OF_BUSINESS`).

title: Pharmacy Claim Flow
description: Pharmacy → switch → PBM real-time adjudication → response → (optional COB/copay secondary) → reversal if not picked up → PBM invoices plan and manufacturer.

title: NCPDP Telecommunication D.0
description: HIPAA-named standard for real-time pharmacy claims (E1 eligibility, B1 bill, B2 reverse, B3 rebill).

title: Pharmacy Claim Status & Reject Codes
description: Paid, rejected, reversed and captured states with NCPDP reject codes; LAAD carries `CLAIM_STATUS` and `REJECT_CODE`.

title: Copay Card Secondary Claim
description: Manufacturer copay assistance processed as a secondary NCPDP claim on its own BIN/PCN; flagged as `COPAY_CARD_FLAG` in LAAD.

title: Medical Claim Flow
description: Provider → 837P/837I → clearinghouse → payer adjudication → 835 remittance; 270/271 eligibility, 276/277 status, 278 PA.

title: X12 837P (Professional)
description: Electronic CMS-1500: billing/rendering NPI, ICD-10-CM diagnoses, CPT/HCPCS lines with units, modifiers, place of service and NDC (N4).

title: X12 837I (Institutional)
description: Electronic UB-04: type of bill, revenue codes, ICD-10-PCS, DRG, attending NPI.

title: X12 835 Remittance
description: Payment/remittance advice with claim- and line-level paid amounts and CARC/RARC adjustment codes.

title: ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, POS
description: Diagnosis (ICD-10-CM), procedure (CPT/HCPCS), place-of-service and revenue code systems on medical claims.

title: Buy-and-Bill
description: Practice buys drug from a specialty distributor, administers it, and bills the J-code on the medical benefit (Part B pays ASP+6%).

title: White / Brown / Clear Bagging
description: Alternatives to buy-and-bill where an SP ships patient-specific drug to the provider (white), the patient carries it (brown) or a health-system SP supplies it (clear).

title: Open vs Closed Claims
description: Closed claims come from payers and are complete for enrolled members; open claims come from switches/clearinghouses with broad but incomplete coverage.

title: EDI 850 / 855 Purchase Order & Acknowledgment
description: Wholesaler order to manufacturer/3PL and its acknowledgment.

title: EDI 856 Advance Ship Notice
description: Shipment notice; carries DSCSA transaction information with serialised EPCIS data.

title: EDI 810 Invoice
description: Invoice for shipped product (ex-factory sale).

title: EDI 857 Shipment and Billing Notice
description: Combined shipment + invoice transaction (an 856 and 810 in one); occasionally used by 3PLs. If a feed is labelled '857' but carries resale lines, it is usually an 867.

title: EDI 867 Product Transfer & Resale Report
description: Wholesaler/3PL report of product sold or transferred to downstream customers, including returns.

title: EDI 852 Product Activity Data
description: Distribution-centre inventory, receipts and sales by product.

title: EDI 844 / 849 Chargeback Claim & Response
description: Wholesaler claim for the difference between WAC and a contract price, and the manufacturer response.

title: EDI 845 Price Authorization
description: Contract/membership eligibility sent to wholesalers.

title: EDI 940 / 945 Warehouse Shipping Order & Advice
description: Manufacturer instruction to 3PL and 3PL confirmation.

title: EPCIS / DSCSA Traceability
description: GS1 EPCIS events for serialised package-level tracing required by DSCSA.

title: Product & Trade Data Flow
description: Manufacturer → 3PL → wholesaler / specialty distributor → pharmacy or provider, and the EDI each hop generates.

title: WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost)
description: Manufacturer list price to wholesalers before discounts (warehouse: `WAC`, `WAC_DOLLARS`).

title: AWP (Average Wholesale Price)
description: Compendia benchmark (≈ WAC × 1.2) still used in PBM pricing.

title: ASP (Average Sales Price)
description: Quarterly net-price average reported to CMS; Part B pays ASP + 6%.

title: AMP (Average Manufacturer Price)
description: Average price paid by retail-community wholesalers/pharmacies; base of Medicaid and 340B.

title: Best Price
description: Lowest price to any eligible commercial customer; drives Medicaid URA.

title: URA (Unit Rebate Amount)
description: Medicaid rebate per unit = basic (23.1% of AMP or AMP − BP) + CPI-U inflation penalty.

title: 340B Ceiling Price
description: AMP − URA per unit.

title: FSS / Federal Ceiling Price
description: VA Federal Supply Schedule and Big Four ceiling prices.

title: MFP (Maximum Fair Price)
description: IRA-negotiated Medicare price, effectuated through the Medicare Transaction Facilitator.

title: Chargeback
description: Wholesaler claim for WAC minus the customer's contract price (GPO, IDN, 340B, FSS).

title: Commercial / PBM Rebate
description: Rebates and admin fees paid to PBMs/plans on utilisation invoices for formulary position.

title: Medicaid Rebate
description: URA × utilisation units invoiced quarterly by states.

title: Part D Manufacturer Discount
description: 10% (initial) / 20% (catastrophic) discounts under the IRA Manufacturer Discount Program.

title: Copay Program Cost
description: Manufacturer spend on copay assistance.

title: Distribution Service Fees
description: Fee-for-service paid to wholesalers and SPs.

title: Gross-to-Net (GTN)
description: WAC × units minus chargebacks, rebates, government discounts, copay, fees, returns and prompt pay = net revenue.

title: Dataset Type Taxonomy
description: How US pharma commercial datasets are classified: what they measure, at what grain, and whether they are projected or census.

title: Which Dataset Answers Which Question
description: Question-to-dataset routing guide for analysts and agents.

title: Ex-Factory Sales (Sell-In)
description: Manufacturer's own invoices to wholesalers/3PL customers — the revenue record before any downstream resale.

title: Wholesaler / Specialty Distributor 867 (Sell-Through)
description: Downstream resale lines from a wholesaler or specialty distributor to each ship-to account (hospital, clinic, pharmacy), including returns.

title: 3PL 867 (Direct Sales Through a 3PL)
description: 867-format sales and returns from a manufacturer's 3PL, covering orders the 3PL ships directly to wholesalers, specialty distributors or end accounts.

title: ICS 867 (Cencora ICS 3PL Sales Feed)
description: The 867 sales/returns feed delivered by Cencora's ICS 3PL; the core sales source of the ICS Sales Warehouse (nexora_poc_catalog).

title: 852 Inventory / Product Activity
description: Wholesaler distribution-centre inventory on hand, receipts and sales by product.

title: IQVIA DDD (Outlet-Level Sales)
description: Projected weekly/monthly sales from distributors to individual outlets (hospitals, clinics, pharmacies), classified by outlet type.

title: SNR Sales Feed (Market × Product, with 340B Flag)
description: Weekly/monthly market- and product-level sales feed (WAC $, AWP, volume/pack/extended units) with a 340B transaction flag, as loaded in the ICS Sales Warehouse.

title: IQVIA National Sales Perspectives (NSP)
description: Projected national $ and unit purchases by channel (retail, clinics, hospitals, LTC, mail, etc.).

title: IQVIA NPA (National Prescription Audit)
description: Projected national dispensed prescriptions (TRx/NRx) by product and channel.

title: IQVIA Xponent (Prescriber-Level Rx)
description: Projected weekly dispensed prescriptions by prescriber and product across retail, mail and LTC.

title: IQVIA Xponent PlanTrak
description: Prescriber-level Rx split by payer plan to measure access and pull-through.

title: Symphony Health (ICON) PHAST Prescription
description: Projected prescriber- and national-level Rx from Symphony's integrated dataverse.

title: IQVIA MIDAS
description: Global audited pharmaceutical sales across countries, used for global market sizing.

title: Open Pharmacy (Rx) Claims
description: De-identified NCPDP claims captured from pharmacies and switches regardless of payer; broad but not enrollment-complete.

title: Open Medical (Mx/Dx) Claims
description: De-identified 837 professional/institutional claims from clearinghouses and practice-management systems.

title: Closed (Payer-Adjudicated) Claims
description: Medical and pharmacy claims from health plans for enrolled members, with eligibility files — complete for each member's enrolled period.

title: IQVIA LAAD (Longitudinal Access & Adjudication Data)
description: Patient-level dataset combining IQVIA Rx, lifecycle (paid/rejected/reversed), medical and remittance claims; includes copay card, source-of-business and new-to-brand flags.

title: IQVIA LRx (Longitudinal Prescription Claims)
description: Patient-level dispensed Rx claims from pharmacies, payers, software providers and clearinghouses (~4B claims/yr since 2006).

title: IQVIA FIA (Formulary Impact Analyzer / Lifecycle Claims)
description: Paid, rejected and reversed claims captured at the point of sale to measure payer friction.

title: IQVIA Dx / Hx (Professional & Institutional Claims)
description: Unadjudicated office (Dx) and hospital (Hx) medical claims (~2B per year).

title: Komodo Healthcare Map
description: Komodo Health's linked, de-identified patient-journey dataset combining open and closed medical, pharmacy, lab and EHR data for 330M+ US patients.

title: Komodo Claims Extracts (Mx / Rx)
description: Brand- or market-specific patient-level medical and pharmacy claims extracts delivered from the Healthcare Map.

title: Symphony Health (ICON) Integrated Dataverse
description: Patient-level Rx and medical claims linked by token across open and closed sources.

title: HealthVerity Marketplace Data
description: Tokenised, licensable claims, EHR, lab and consumer data that can be linked across suppliers.

title: CMS Medicare FFS Claims (ResDAC / VRDC)
description: Research-identifiable Medicare Parts A/B/D claims available under CMS data use agreements.

title: Remittance (835) Data
description: Payment outcomes for medical claims from 835 files: paid amounts, denials and adjustment reasons.

title: Komodo Claims by Provider (HCP × Affiliation Aggregate)
description: Komodo claims aggregated to HCP with affiliated organisation and system, rolling time windows (C3M/C6M/C12M), total vs non-hemodialysis volume and claims.

title: CMS Medicare Part D Prescribers PUF
description: Public Medicare Part D claims and costs by prescriber NPI and drug.

title: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners PUF
description: Public Part B services and payments by NPI and HCPCS (includes J-codes).

title: NPPES NPI File
description: CMS registry of all NPIs with names, addresses, taxonomy codes and entity type.

title: IQVIA OneKey
description: Validated HCP/HCO reference data with affiliations, specialties and contact details.

title: Veeva OpenData / Network
description: Veeva HCP/HCO reference data and MDM hub issuing VIDs, custom keys and hierarchies.

title: AMA Physician Masterfile
description: Record of US physicians incl. residents, with ME numbers, specialties and PDRP status.

title: HCP–HCO Affiliation
description: Many-to-many links between HCPs and the organisations/systems where they practise, with role and primary flag.

title: Zip-to-Territory (ZTT) Alignment
description: Effective-dated mapping of 5-digit zip → territory → region → nation, plus account-level overrides.

title: Account / Network Alignment
description: Account-level (VID-based) territory assignment that can override zip alignment for key accounts.

title: Claims Drug Mapping (NDC → Product/Market)
description: Lookup mapping NDC11/USC to product, molecule, form, strength and market (e.g. IQVIA claims drug mapping).

title: Calendar / Time Dimension
description: Canonical calendar with week-ending, month, quarter, trimester and rolling-window flags aligned to vendor data weeks.

title: CRM Call Activity (Veeva)
description: Rep and MSL interactions recorded in CRM: calls, approved emails (RTE), meetings, products discussed and samples.

title: Sample Transactions
description: PDMA-regulated sample disbursements with lot numbers and signatures.

title: Speaker Program Data
description: Events, speakers, attendees and honoraria for promotional speaker programmes.

title: CMS Open Payments
description: Public record of manufacturer and GPO transfers of value to physicians, NPPs and teaching hospitals.

title: Digital & Omnichannel Engagement
description: HCP email opens, web/portal visits, webinars and programmatic media exposure.

title: Promotional Audit (Competitive)
description: Panel-based estimates of competitor details, samples and spend.

title: Formulary & Policy Data
description: Plan-level coverage, tier, PA/step-therapy policy and covered lives by product.

title: Payer & Covered Lives
description: Enrollment counts by plan, PBM, channel and geography.

title: Hub / Patient Services Data
description: Case records from manufacturer hubs: enrolments, benefit verification, PA support, financial assistance, SP triage.

title: Specialty Pharmacy Data Feed
description: Status and dispense records from network SPs (referral received, PA pending, shipped, discontinued).

title: Copay Program Data
description: Claims paid by the manufacturer copay programme via its BIN/PCN.

title: ePA Transaction Data
description: Electronic prior authorisation requests and outcomes.

title: EHR Data
description: De-identified electronic health record data (problems, meds, vitals, notes-derived).

title: Lab Results Data
description: De-identified lab results with LOINC codes and values.

title: Mortality Data
description: Death records linked by token to claims (e.g. LAAD enhanced with mortality).

title: Consumer & SDOH Data
description: Socioeconomic and lifestyle attributes linked to de-identified patients.

title: Contracts & Customer Eligibility
description: Contract terms, tiers, price lists and eligible-member rosters (GPO, IDN, PBM, 340B).

title: Chargeback Data (844/849)
description: Wholesaler chargeback claims and manufacturer responses per resale line.

title: Rebate Utilisation Invoices
description: PBM/plan invoices listing claim-level or aggregated utilisation subject to rebates.

title: Medicaid State Invoices (CMS-R-144)
description: Quarterly state invoices of utilisation units × URA.

title: Government Pricing Calculations
description: Monthly/quarterly AMP, BP, ASP, 340B ceiling and FSS calculations from all eligible transactions.

title: Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
description: Field employee who delivers on-label product messages, samples and access information to HCPs and accounts; measured on calls, reach/frequency and territory sales.

title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL)
description: Non-promotional scientific role engaging KOLs and answering unsolicited medical questions; separate from sales.

title: Key Account Manager
description: Manages IDNs, health systems and large accounts (contracts, P&T, pathways).

title: Field Reimbursement Manager
description: Supports offices with benefit verification, PA and coding within Anti-Kickback limits.

title: Targeting, Segmentation & Deciling
description: Ranks HCPs/accounts into deciles by market volume (Rx, claims, sales) and potential to decide who reps call on.

title: Call Plan
description: Target list × planned frequency per cycle for each territory.

title: Territory Design & Alignment
description: Assignment of geographies (zips) and accounts to territories, balancing workload and potential; usually realigned annually.

title: Sales Force Sizing
description: Rep count = targets × frequency ÷ capacity, tested against response curves.

title: CRM for Life Sciences
description: System recording accounts, calls, samples, approved emails and events (Veeva CRM/Vault CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, IQVIA OCE).

title: Sampling & Sample Accountability
description: Distribution of free samples under PDMA with signed requests, lot tracking and reconciliation.

title: Incentive Compensation (IC)
description: Rep payout computed from goals and credited sales (867/DDD, Xponent, SP) via alignment rules.

title: Omnichannel Engagement & Next Best Action
description: Coordinated rep, email, web and media touches with model-driven next-best-action suggestions.

title: Customer Master Data Management (MDM)
description: Golden HCP/HCO records built by matching NPPES, OneKey, Veeva, AMA, DEA/HIN and source keys; every sales/claims feed is mastered to it.

title: HCO Hierarchy
description: System (IDN) → organisation → site/department hierarchy; in the warehouse SYS_VID → ORG_VID.

title: Prescriber & Ship-to Matching
description: Mapping vendor IDs (IMS ID, DEA, HIN, custom keys) to master VIDs/NPIs; the unmatched rate is a key data-quality KPI.

title: Hub Services
description: Manufacturer-funded patient services: benefit verification, PA support, financial assistance triage, SP routing, adherence.

title: Copay Assistance
description: Manufacturer cards reducing commercial patients' out-of-pocket cost; excluded for federal programmes under the AKS.

title: Copay Accumulators & Maximizers
description: Plan designs where assistance doesn't count toward deductible/OOP or is spread to exhaust programme maximums.

title: Patient Assistance Program (PAP)
description: Free drug for uninsured/underinsured patients via a foundation or manufacturer programme.

title: Specialty Pharmacy Network Design
description: Open, limited or exclusive SP networks with data and service agreements.

title: Payer Contracting & Pull-Through
description: Negotiating formulary position for rebates, then ensuring field teams communicate the win.

title: Contract Research Organization (CRO)
description: Clinical trial design, site management, monitoring, data management, biostatistics and submissions.

title: CDMO / CMO
description: Contract development and manufacturing of APIs, drug products and biologics, fill-finish and packaging.

title: Commercial Data Provider
description: Licenses Rx, claims, sales, reference and formulary data.

title: Tokenization & Privacy
description: De-identification, patient tokens and HIPAA expert determinations for linking data.

title: CRM & Commercial Software
description: CRM, content/MLR, reference data and MDM platforms.

title: Commercial Analytics & Consulting
description: Targeting, alignment, sizing, IC, forecasting, launch, brand analytics, data management and BI (often with offshore delivery).

title: IT & Data Platform Services
description: Data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), integration, MDM implementation and AI engineering.

title: Contract Sales Organization (CSO)
description: Outsourced field sales forces and inside sales.

title: Hub & Patient Services Providers
description: Hub operations, BV/PA, copay administration, nurse educators.

title: 3PL & Specialty Logistics
description: Warehousing, order-to-cash, cold chain and DSCSA serialisation.

title: GTN, Contracting & Channel Data Management
description: Contract management, chargebacks, rebates, government pricing, and aggregation of 867/852/SP feeds.

title: Market Access, Pricing & HEOR
description: Value dossiers, pricing strategy, HEOR and RWE studies.

title: Regulatory & Pharmacovigilance Outsourcing
description: Submission publishing, AE case processing and signal detection.

title: Medical Communications & Healthcare Marketing Agencies
description: Publications, medical information, HCP/DTC creative and media.

title: Compliance & Transparency Services
description: Open Payments aggregate spend, speaker-programme management, state reporting.

title: Service Engagement Models
description: How pharma buys services: FSP, full-service outsourcing, SaaS subscription, data licence, managed services/offshore delivery and project consulting.

title: IQVIA
description: Largest provider of pharma data (Xponent, NPA, DDD, LAAD, OneKey), analytics, CRO and CSO services.

title: Komodo Health
description: Healthcare data and analytics company whose Healthcare Map links open and closed claims for 330M+ patients.

title: Symphony Health (ICON)
description: Rx and claims data provider owned by ICON.

title: Veeva Systems
description: CRM, OpenData/Network MDM and Vault applications for life sciences.

title: Surescripts
description: Dominant US e-prescribing network (eRx, EPCS, RTPB, medication history, ePA).

title: Datavant
description: Patient tokenisation and data-linking network.

title: IntegriChain
description: Channel data management (867/852/SP aggregation), contracting and GTN platforms.

title: MMIT
description: Formulary, policy and payer-lives data.

title: Market Share
description: Brand TRx/NRx/NBRx, units or $ divided by the market basket total for the same dataset and period.

title: Persistence
description: Share of patients still on therapy N days after start (allowing a gap), from patient-level claims.

title: Adherence (PDC / MPR)
description: Proportion of days covered or medication possession ratio over a period.

title: Lines of Therapy
description: Sequencing of regimens per patient using claims rules (gap, add-on, switch).

title: Patient Journey
description: Diagnosis → referral → Rx → PA → dispense/administration → persistence, built from linked claims and hub/SP data.

title: Time to Therapy
description: Days from referral/written date to first dispense or administration.

title: Approval, Rejection & Abandonment Rates
description: Initial vs final claim outcomes from lifecycle claims (LAAD/FIA).

title: Payer Mix
description: Distribution of a brand's volume by channel (commercial, Part D, Medicaid, cash).

title: Reach & Frequency
description: Share of targets called and average calls per target per period, from CRM.

title: Promotion Response
description: Statistical lift in Rx/sales attributable to calls, samples and digital touches.

title: Launch Tracking
description: Early indicators for new brands: trial prescribers, NBRx, access, time to therapy.

title: Loss of Exclusivity & Generic Erosion
description: Volume and price decline after generic/biosimilar entry.

title: GTN Rate
description: Total deductions ÷ gross sales.

title: Channel Inventory / Days on Hand
description: Ex-factory sell-in minus 867 sell-through, or 852 on-hand ÷ daily demand.

title: Forecasting
description: Patient- or trend-based demand and revenue projections.

title: Prescription to Pharmacy Claim (hop by hop)
description: From the HCP's order to PBM rebate invoices, with the dataset captured at each hop.

title: Physician-Administered (IV) Drug Flow
description: Manufacturer → 3PL/specialty distributor → clinic/hospital (867) → administration → 837 medical claim (J-code) → Komodo/LAAD Mx claims.

title: Medical Claim Data Flow
description: Provider → clearinghouse → payer → 835; captured as open claims (clearinghouse) and closed claims (payer).

title: Product, Trade & Chargeback Flow
description: Ex-factory → 3PL → wholesaler → account with 867/852/844 data and contract pricing.

title: Money Flow
description: Wholesaler pays WAC; PBM reimburses pharmacy; plan pays PBM; manufacturer pays chargebacks, rebates, Medicaid/Part D discounts and copay.

title: HCP
description: Individual prescriber.

title: HCO
description: Organisation/account (dim_hco).

title: Patient

title: Product
description: Drug package and its hierarchy.

title: Prescription
description: Order and its fills.

title: Pharmacy Claim
description: NCPDP transaction / final fill.

title: Medical Claim
description: 837 claim and lines.

title: Payer / Plan
description: Benefit plan.

title: PBM
description: Pharmacy benefit manager.

title: Pharmacy
description: Dispensing location.

title: Territory
description: Sales geography (effective-dated).

title: Rep
description: Field user.

title: Call
description: CRM interaction.

title: Sample
description: Sample disbursement.

title: Shipment / Sale Line
description: 867 or ex-factory line.

title: Contract
description: Pricing agreement.

title: Chargeback
description: 844 line.

title: Rebate
description: Rebate invoice line.

title: Transfer of Value
description: Open Payments record.

title: Xponent → HCP → Territory
description: Map IMS_PRESCRIBER_ID/NPI_ID to the master HCP, then HCP zip → ZTT territory.

title: Claims → Product
description: Normalise NDC to 11 digits → drug mapping/product master → NDC-9 roll-up; for medical lines use HCPCS → NDC crosswalk with unit conversion.

title: 867 → HCO → System
description: Ship-to DEA/HIN/custom key → Veeva custom-key crosswalk → ORG_VID → SYS_VID; then account/zip alignment.

title: Pharmacy Claim → Plan → Formulary
description: BIN+PCN+Group or PLAN_ID → plan master → formulary status at date of service.

title: Patient Linkage Across Sources
description: Token-to-token linkage across LAAD, Komodo, EHR, lab, hub/SP — only under expert determination and licence.

title: CRM Calls → Rx / Claims Volume
description: HCP_VID (or NPI_VOD) joins calls to Xponent and Komodo-by-provider; analyse with a lagged response window.

title: 867 Sales ↔ Komodo Claims (IV drugs)
description: Join at HCO/system level: fct_ics_867.ORG_VID/SYS_VID = AFFILIATED_ORG_VID/AFFILIATED_SYSTEM_VID (cast DOUBLE VIDs to string first) to compare purchases vs administrations.
